tool_args.rationale: The largest pilot gradient is 2.44, below the candidate threshold of 2.50–2.68. The avalanche term is therefore zero on every pilot row throughout that interval. The high-gradient probe directly tests whether the sink activates above the threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Smooth siphon with a square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It can explain the subcritical plateau but cannot establish whether the response drops above the threshold.
All pilot gradients are below the candidate threshold interval, so the threshold and avalanche strength are not identifiable yet.
It costs more and targets trajectory resolution rather than the missing above-threshold contrast.
